name: Peanut Nougat
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Shell, remove skins, and finely chop peanuts.
Put sugar in a perfectly smooth granite saucepan, place on range, and stir constantly until melted to a syrup, taking care to keep sugar from sides of pan.
Add nut meat, pour at once into a warm buttered tin, and mark in small squares.
If sugar is not removed from range as soon as melted, it will quickly caramelize.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
